tasks.name: Continuous-position interpolation across piecewise + Stefan + classifier
tasks.deliverable: piecewise.py and stefan.py: x_core and x_surface use parabolic interpolation around the chosen anchor sensor (vertex of parabola through anchor and two neighbours) and adjacency-gradient interpolation for surface (linear interpolation between the two sensors with the largest gradient). classifier.py: PositionalAssignment.temperature_series is a true spatial interpolation per timestep at the continuous position_normalised, not the nearest sensor's raw series. profile.py: helper interpolate_temperature_series_at(df, positions, x) -> pd.Series. Existing tests stay green; existing test_classify_returns_position_between_sensors strengthened to assert position_normalised strictly off-sensor. New tests in tests/test_spatial_reconstruction_interpolation.py covering parabolic interpolation, surface adjacency interpolation, and per-timestep series interpolation. Sidebar shows current inferred core position (e.g. 'between T3 and T4 at x=0.42') for the user.
tasks.validation_required: All M1a-M5 + sidebar fix tests still pass. position_normalised demonstrably between sensors on at least one synthetic case. temperature_series differs from df[nearest_sensor] when position is off-sensor. Sidebar shows inferred position.
